dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm taking a Thai cooking class on Wednesday evening. Come with me!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈteɪkɪŋ ə ˈtaɪ ˈkʊkɪŋ ˌklæs ɑːn ˈwɛnzdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ. ˈkʌm wɪð miː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That sounds fun! What time is it?
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈfʌn! ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm ɪz ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, I'm meeting Ploy on Wednesday evening. Maybe next time.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪm ˈmiːtɪŋ ˈplɔɪ ɑːn ˈwɛnzdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ. ˌmeɪbi nɛkst ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Never mind. Then why don't you come to my place on Friday? We can cook together.
dialogue.reading: ˌnɛvər ˈmaɪnd. ˈðɛn ˈwaɪ ˈdoʊnt juː ˈkʌm tə maɪ ˈpleɪs ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ? wiː kən ˈkʊk təˈɡɛðər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Why not? That sounds like a good plan.
dialogue.reading: ˌwaɪ ˈnɑːt? ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈlaɪk ə ˈɡʊd ˈplæn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sounds good! And I'll make Thai iced tea.
dialogue.reading: ˌsaʊndz ˈɡʊd! ənd aɪl ˈmeɪk ˈtaɪ ˈaɪst ˈtiː.
